title: Types and collapse for cuspidal representations of groups acting on trees
summary: In a previous paper, the second author proved that every supercuspidal representation of a rank-one p-adic group is induced from a compact-mod-center open subgroup. The method was geometric, localizing representations to obtain equivariant sheaves on trees. Here we provide two refinements. The first is a geometric description of the inducing data, via a geometrically minimal K-type. Second is a proof that the equivariant sheaves collapse onto injective sheaves.
